contract: Retain every original full-boundary coordinate bit
Replace only the traced 275 cap rows using the independently checked cap and source indices
Add only the checked 8125 interior cap points; preserve every other oriented facet and construction tag
Preserve every mapped marked edge and the literal cap contour
Recheck the full closed surface and actual 3MF before any volume proposal
A new surface is not a conforming volume; retain the previous volume unchanged
